title.value: Old Dog Learns New Tricks: Randomized UCB for Bandit Problems
title.justification: The title of the paper explicitly mentioned as 'Old Dog Learns New Tricks: Randomized UCB for Bandit Problems'.
title.quote: Old Dog Learns New Tricks: Randomized UCB for Bandit Problems

analysis.description: The paper introduces RandUCB, a bandit strategy combining confidence intervals akin to UCB (Upper Confidence Bound) algorithms with randomization similar to Thompson Sampling (TS) to trade off exploration and exploitation. This strategy is applied to both multi-armed and structured bandit settings, achieving minimax-optimal regret.

type.justification: The paper focuses on theoretical derivations and performance guarantees of the RandUCB algorithm in bandit settings, including minimax-optimal regret and specific performance bounds.
type.quote: We propose RandUCB, a bandit strategy that builds on theoretically derived confidence intervals similar to upper confidence bound (UCB) algorithms...
